title.zh: v2.1.6 跨语言常量只留一份：数字由 TS 写进 CSS
title.en: v2.1.6 One Copy of Each Cross-Language Constant: TS Writes the Numbers into CSS

highlights.zh: **同一个数字写两遍，靠一条测试钉住——这是第三次了。** 手机宽/高断点（639 / 500）和共享底栏里走带条的宽度（320）都在 CSS 与 TS 各有一份，前两次的处理都是再写一条「两份必须相等」的守卫。问题是它防不住**第三份**：新加一个跨语言常量时，除非作者记得补一条守卫，没有任何东西会失败——而当年 480/500 那次（横屏 490px 视口拿到压缩样式表、JS 仍当它是高手机）就是人工发现的。
highlights.en: **The same number written twice and pinned by a test — for the third time.** The phone width and height boundaries (639 / 500) and the shared bottom row's transport width (320) each existed on both sides of the CSS/TS line, and the first two rounds answered with another "the two copies must match" guard. highlights.zh: **所以只留一份**：三个数字搬进 `src/platform/layoutTokens.ts`，`scripts/layout_tokens.mjs` 把它们写进 `src/index.css`（`npm run layout:sync`），`npm run check:layout` 接进 `verify`——与 `ROADMAP_V2.md` 的版本头同一套办法。**媒体查询不能读 CSS 变量**（`@media (max-width: var(--x))` 不合法），所以生成的是数字本身；`--mobile-transport-row-w` 才是真正的变量，也由同一份 token 写。
highlights.en: **So there is one copy.** The three numbers live in `src/platform/layoutTokens.ts`; `scripts/layout_tokens.mjs` writes them into `src/index.css` (`npm run layout:sync`), and `npm run check:layout` sits inside `verify` — the same arrangement as the version header in `ROADMAP_V2.md`. **A media query cannot read a custom property** (`@media (max-width: var(--x))` is not valid), so what gets generated is the number itself; `--mobile-transport-row-w` is a real variable and is wri…

highlights.zh: **匹配锚在规则语法上，删掉规则也算漂移。** 三条模式都锚定 `@media (max-width: …) {` 这样的完整规则，而不是搜 `d+`——否则释义注释里的 639、以及无关的 `--trk-head-w: 142px` 都会被改写，门禁就变成在检查自己。反过来，模式完全匹配不上时报 `found: null` 并失败：把媒体查询整块删掉，不该因为「没有可比的东西」而通过。
highlights.en: **The patterns are anchored to rule syntax, and a deleted rule counts as drift.** All three match a complete rule such as `@media (max-width: …) {` rather than searching for `\d+` — otherwise the 639 inside an explanatory comment, or the unrelated `--trk-head-w: 142px`, would be rewritten and the gate would end up checking itself.
